description: This source file defines the 'InvokeMethodOptions' enumeration used for specifying options when invoking methods within Orleans' code generation framework. It includes flags such as 'OneWay', 'ReadOnly', 'AlwaysInterleave', and 'Unordered', which are used in invocation requests and are critical for generated invoker behavior.

classes.name: InvokeMethodOptions
classes.description: An enum representing various invocation options as flags for method invocation within the Orleans framework.
